deltas.subject: Restore Binance Futures close-all reconciliation
deltas.reason: Adds concrete Rust execution-client reconciliation requirements for quantity-free Binance Futures close-all orders: pair open-order and position reports, restore side-aware quantities, and keep direct tests.

deltas.subject: Tighten Polymarket reconciliation regression coverage (#4855)
deltas.reason: Strengthens Rust adapter reconciliation coverage for valid, skipped, incomplete, and malformed Polymarket fill/report data; current generic uncertainty guidance covers the contract, but review/test checklists should name completeness and malformed-data paths.

deltas.subject: Stabilize OKX task lifecycle tests
deltas.reason: Confirms Rust adapter lifecycle tests should await exact task completion/cancellation instead of sleeps; current deterministic async testing guidance already covers this behavior, so no prose correction is required.

deltas.subject: Prevent LiveNodeBuilder re-entry panics
deltas.reason: Changes the PyO3 LiveNodeBuilder boundary: Python factory re-entry is rejected instead of aborting. Guidance needs a single-use builder/factory contract and a regression expectation.

deltas.subject: Fix LiveNode position fill reconciliation
deltas.reason: Corrects Rust LiveNode fill reconciliation so position reports are applied when instrument and position IDs resolve; guidance needs explicit same-position fill/restart coverage.

deltas.subject: Standardize adapter decimal precision
deltas.reason: Adds an official Rust adapter precision contract: choose scale from field semantics, normalize non-semantic padding, use explicit instrument/currency dp where governed, and never infer discrete precision from incidental payload formatting.

deltas.subject: Share the execution event emitter sender across clones (#4874)
deltas.reason: ExecutionEventEmitter clones now share one Arc-backed mpsc sender. Existing architecture guidance does not teach emitter construction; record as reviewed internal implementation with no API correction.

deltas.subject: Optimize ExecutionEngine position updates
deltas.reason: Optimizes Rust ExecutionEngine position updates and removes transient position-open events in same-fill open-close paths; reviewers/tests should assert lifecycle semantics rather than implementation event-count assumptions.
